table.title: Equivalent R and SPSS syntax
rows:
df <- read.csv("review-survey.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, na.strings = c('', 'NA', 'null', 'NULL'))
best <- as.character(df$best); worst <- as.character(df$worst)
labs <- sort(unique(c(best, worst)))
sc <- sapply(labs, function(item) sum(best == item) - sum(worst == item))
cat(sprintf('score1=%.16g\n', unname(sc[1])))
cat(sprintf('n=%.16g\n', nrow(df)))
